# ExDNA v1.5.3 - Table of Contents

> Code duplication detector powered by Elixir AST analysis

## Pages

- [ExDNA 🧬](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [ExDNA](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.md): Code duplication detector for Elixir, powered by native AST analysis.
- [ExDNA.AST.Annotator](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.AST.Annotator.md): Pre-processes the AST to handle source comments that suppress clone detection.
- [ExDNA.AST.AntiUnifier](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.AST.AntiUnifier.md): Computes the *anti-unification* (most specific generalization) of two ASTs.
- [ExDNA.AST.ClauseGrouper](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.AST.ClauseGrouper.md): Groups consecutive function clauses with the same name/arity into synthetic
compound nodes so the fingerprinter can detect duplicated multi-clause functions.
- [ExDNA.AST.EditDistance](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.AST.EditDistance.md): Computes structural similarity between two ASTs using a simplified
tree edit distance.
- [ExDNA.AST.Fingerprint](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.AST.Fingerprint.md): Computes structural fingerprints (hashes) for AST subtrees.
- [ExDNA.AST.Normalizer](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.AST.Normalizer.md): Normalizes Elixir AST for structural comparison.
- [ExDNA.AST.PipeNormalizer](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.AST.PipeNormalizer.md): Normalizes pipe operators to nested function calls.
- [ExDNA.Cache](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Cache.md): Persistent cache for fingerprinted AST fragments.
- [ExDNA.Compiler](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Compiler.md): A `Mix.Task.Compiler` that runs clone detection incrementally.
- [ExDNA.Config](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Config.md): Configuration for ExDNA.
- [ExDNA.Credo](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Credo.md): ## Basics
- [ExDNA.Detection.Clone](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Detection.Clone.md): Represents a detected code clone — a group of structurally identical fragments.

- [ExDNA.Detection.Detector](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Detection.Detector.md): Orchestrates the clone detection pipeline.
- [ExDNA.Detection.Filter](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Detection.Filter.md): Prunes overlapping and nested clones.
- [ExDNA.Detection.Fuzzy](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Detection.Fuzzy.md): Type-III (near-miss) clone detection.
- [ExDNA.Detection.Grouper](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Detection.Grouper.md): Groups clones by the directories they span so reporters can produce
higher-level summaries.

- [ExDNA.Detection.LSH](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Detection.LSH.md): Locality-Sensitive Hashing for fast approximate nearest-neighbor search
on sub-hash sets.
- [ExDNA.LSP](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.LSP.md): Language Server Protocol server for ExDNA.
- [ExDNA.Refactor.BehaviourSuggestion](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Refactor.BehaviourSuggestion.md): Detects clone groups where the same function is implemented identically
across multiple modules, suggesting a behaviour extraction.
- [ExDNA.Refactor.MacroSuggestion](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Refactor.MacroSuggestion.md): Detects clone groups that should be refactored into macros rather than functions.
- [ExDNA.Refactor.Suggestion](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Refactor.Suggestion.md): Generates refactoring suggestions from detected clones.
- [ExDNA.Report](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Report.md): Analysis results: detected clones and summary statistics.

- [ExDNA.Reporter](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Reporter.md): Behaviour for ExDNA output reporters.

- [ExDNA.Reporter.Console](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Reporter.Console.md): Pretty-prints clone detection results to the terminal.
- [ExDNA.Reporter.HTML](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Reporter.HTML.md): Generates a self-contained HTML report file for clone detection results.
- [ExDNA.Reporter.JSON](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Reporter.JSON.md): Outputs clone detection results as JSON to stdout.
- [ExDNA.Reporter.SARIF](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/ExDNA.Reporter.SARIF.md): Outputs clone detection results in SARIF 2.1.0 format.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ex_dna](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExDna.md): Scans your project for duplicated code blocks using AST analysis.
- [mix ex_dna.explain](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExDna.Explain.md): Deep-dive into a specific clone, showing the anti-unification result,
the common structure, the divergence points (holes), and the suggested
refactoring.
- [mix ex_dna.lsp](https://ex-dna.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExDna.Lsp.md): Starts the ExDNA Language Server Protocol server over stdio.
